title: Harden Body parameterized variants with range validation
description:
Codex review finding (swisseph-rs/1): the parameterized Body variants (Fictitious, Asteroid, PlanetMoon, Comet) accept unchecked i32 payloads. Callers can construct invalid values that bypass TryFrom's range checks — e.g. Body::Asteroid(-10000).to_raw_id() aliases SE_SUN (0), Body::Fictitious(23) emits a gap ID.

Fix: validate ranges in constructors or to_raw_id(). Either checked constructor functions that return Result, or validate in to_raw_id() itself.

acceptance_criteria.text: Body::Fictitious, Asteroid, PlanetMoon, Comet cannot be constructed with out-of-range payloads
to_raw_id() cannot produce values that alias named body IDs (0-22) or fall in gaps (23-39)
Existing TryFrom<i32> remains the canonical safe entry point from C IDs
cargo test passes with new validation tests

execution_record: Introduced four newtypes (FictitiousId, AsteroidId, PlanetMoonId, CometId) with private inner fields and checked constructors. Added convenience constructors on Body (Body::fictitious(), etc.). TryFrom uses module-private field access internally. 9 new tests covering valid ranges, rejection of out-of-range values, aliasing prevention, and TryFrom roundtrips. No divergence from plan.
root_cause: Parameterized Body enum variants (Fictitious(i32), Asteroid(i32), etc.) had public i32 payloads with no range validation. Callers could construct values bypassing TryFrom's range checks — e.g. Body::Asteroid(-10000).to_raw_id() produced 0, aliasing SE_SUN. The scaffold established TryFrom as the safe entry point but left direct construction unchecked.
